content.title: First Round, Charleston vs Duke Live Stream: How to Watch Women's NCAA Basketball Tournament
content.text: No. 3-seeded Duke opens its NCAA tournament run at home on Friday when it faces 14th-seeded Charleston on Friday morning The Duke Blue Devils (24-8) shook off a 3-6 start, rallying to win both the Atlantic Coast Conference regular-season and tournament championships to earn a No. 3 seed in the Sacramento 2 region of the NCAA tournament. The Blue Devils host the first and second rounds at Cameron Indoor Stadium and open play on Friday morning against the No. 14-seeded Charleston Cougars (27-5), the regular-season and tourney champs from the Coastal Athletic Conference. Charleston makes its first March Madness appearance while Duke appears for the fourth straight year and advanced to the Elite Eight in 2025. How to Watch First Round, Charleston vs Duke, in Women’s NCAA Basketball Tournament Today: Game Date: Friday, March 20, 2026 Game Time: 11:30 a.m. ET TV: ESPN2 Location: Cameron Indoor Stadium Live stream the Charleston vs Duke NCAA women’s basketball tournament first-round game on Fubo: Start watching now! Duke wrapped up the ACC tourney title with a 70-65 overtime win over second-seeded Louisville on March 8 in Duluth, Georgia, after escaping a semifinal upset bid by Notre Dame the day before. Toby Fournier leads the Blue Devils with averages of 17.3 points, 8.2 rebounds and 2.3 blocks, with Ashlon Jackson scoring 11.4 points per game and Taina Mair putting up 11.4 points, 5.5 assists and 2.4 steals a night. Charleston played in the WNIT in both 2024 and 2025 before breaking through this season with a 16-2 run through the CAA, followed by a 68-56 victory over Hofstra on Sunday to secure the conference’s automatic bid. Taryn Barbot leads the Cougars with averages of 19.6 points and 2.3 steals while Taylor Barbot posts 11.4 points and 6.0 assists per game and Grace Ezebilo snares 11.9 boards an outing. The Blue Devils come off back-to-back Sweet Sixteen bids and their Elite Eight appearance last season, looking for their first Final Four trip since 2006, when they finished as runner-up. The winner advances to the second round to face either No. 6 seed Baylor or 11th-seeded Nebraska. What Time Is Charleston vs Duke On?
